content: CS primarily targets the “what to say" aspect of evaluation, CO targets the “how to say it" aspect, and RG targets both. Note that for CS, CO, RG-% and BLEU metrics, higher is better; which is not true for RG-#. The IE system used in the experiments is able to extract an average of 17 factual records from gold descriptions. In order to mimic a human expert, a generative system should approach this number and not overload generation with brute facts.
